decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range had its own page in 2018 and 2019 and fits the firm's pharmacy OTC strategy, so with no sign of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for search to reallocate resources.
The skin and hair supplement is a low-cost extension of the established Trivital brand with continued page presence, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results are uncertain.
Joint health is a steady pharmacy segment and the product moved from a mention to its own page in 2019, suggesting it performed at least near aspiration.
The immune supplement was actively promoted in 2019, and pandemic-era demand for immune products likely pushed results above aspiration, so dropping it is unlikely.

Despite the 2018 valsartan contamination recall, the product was still mentioned in 2019, which points to supply being restored, and a generic antihypertensive is a core line a pharma firm usually keeps unless margins collapse.
The OTC triptan fits the firm's established migraine and pain expertise and had its own page, so there is no evidence of a shortfall that would prompt problemistic search.
